Class MoneyManager

java.lang.Object
logic.MoneyManager
public class MoneyManager extends Object
Singleton that manages the player's money throughout a stage.

Money accrues passively each frame via update() at a rate proportional to the current wallet level. The player can spend money to deploy units (spend(int)) or upgrade the wallet capacity (upgradeWallet()). All state is reset between stages via reset().

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Resets all state to initial values for a new stage. Money level returns to 1 and current money is cleared.

    • update

      public void update()
      Advances passive money generation by one frame (called ~60 times per second). Money is capped at maxMoney.
